slots.title: Waymo suspends freeway rides nationwide after California DMV order
slots.author: TechCrunch
slots.summary: The DMV said Waymo's freeway operations pose an imminent hazard to public safety. Restrictions will remain in place until Waymo can demonstrate that it has taken "effective corrective actions" to address the deficiencies.

slots.title: Amazon and Google will together own nearly 30% of Anthropic after its IPO
slots.author: TechCrunch
slots.summary: Amazon will own just under 15% of Anthropic after the IPO, with the option to go much higher. Google is a close second with holdings of nearly 14%.
